text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"News of her 3rd targeted victory at the 
JBC Classic dominated the online trends."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her popularity continued to soar. However, 
Smart Falcon seemed far more concerned 
with the raw numbers showing the hype 
rather than the detailed feedback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, she meets a young girl 
who has been a fan since her early days. 
The girl says, "I love how sparkly you 
are, big sis!" Yet she wonders if she is 
truly shining right now—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Smart Falcon shaken, the Trainer 
decided to talk things out with her before 
their next goal, the Champions Cup.
